parsed.rationale: Both `TestPerson` (CacheCoordinatorTests.swift:71) and `CachedPerson` (CachedFetchTests.swift:257) are `type-alias-object` declarations inside test files within the `Caching` package, yet neither record carries `is_test=true` in its context flags. Merging them into a single shared alias would couple two independent test suites and obscure the intent of each fixture. Given the absence of any non-test consumers and the low confidence that the structural match reflects a real abstraction opportunity, no action is warranted.
